description_expanded: This impressive Alys Beach Vacation Rental home, located on a very private and quiet fully built-out alley, was designed by noted architectural firm Khoury-Vogt and has been featured in several magazines such as VIE and In Niche. The home sits one row back from the Gulf and offers water views from five different rooms thanks to careful placement of front-row homes. Entering from Sea Venture Alley you will find an open courtyard with pool that provides shade much of the day. The ground level offers a bedroom with a queen-sized bed as well as a bunk area with one set of bunk beds. The bedroom and the bunk area share a full bath and are perfect for multiple families seeking separate private areas. The second floor offers a half-bath as well as a spacious great room and open kitchen with a large center island. Both rooms, as well as a balcony off of the great room, provide direct water views. The third floor offers the primary bedroom with a private balcony facing the Gulf and attached primary bathroom with a large sunken tub/shower. Finally, another bedroom on this level offers a king-sized bed, private bathroom and a balcony with water views. Parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
